}}'''Marah''' is a [[novice]] in the [[White Tower]]. She is from [[Murandy]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Marah}}

== Appearance ==
She is stocky with mischievous blue eyes.

She is no more than 15 or 16 years old.

== Activities ==
She is one of the novices who has started calling [[Egwene al'Vere]] Mother behind the White Tower [[Aes Sedai]] backs.
